The intersection point is $(-1, 3)$, which is in the second quadrant. “$l_1$ and $l_2$ intersect at the point $(3, -1)$” is incorrect. Putting it into the equation of $l_1$ gives $6 + 1 + 5 = 12$, not $0$. In fact the intersection point is $(-1, 3)$.
